asked.text: 1. Stock Research sub-agent (retrieval-only). Whenever an analyst agent picks up a ticker, it spawns a per-stock Stock Research sub-agent. The analyst can query it in natural language for specific info or specific timelines/date ranges (e.g. 'gross margin trend 2022-2025', 'what happened around the Aug 14 drop'). It never generates opinions or trades; it only retrieves through gateway tools and returns answers where every fact carries FactRef citation IDs. It's strictly point-in-time (only data available as of simulated date; leakage logged), and there's a configurable per-stock query cap plus cost tracking under the existing budget stop. Sources: prices, all filings, news, industry/macro, options, short interest, ownership, past trade/observation/journal history for that stock.
